text:
sara: heads-up: saw a surge of quota-alarm alerts for "unmapped_project" tonight. Traced to requests that used SA-impersonation via auth-proxy.

tom: interesting. proxy should copy X-Project-ID from the impersonation header into auth.project_id. Any examples?

sara: pasted an example where header is dropped:

```
HTTP/1.1 POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.test
Authorization: Bearer ya29.XXXX
Impersonate-Service-Account: sa:ingest-pipeline
# missing: X-Project-ID
```

ben: if project header is missing, our routing falls back to org-level and quota attribution becomes org-scoped. Console dashboards are project-first so those requests look like zero in project breakdown.

nina: UX pain. Customers see spikes but no project owner in UI. We should show a clear "Unmapped (impersonation)" row with a tooltip linking to docs.

rafael: telemetry fix idea: add `auth.project_resolution` tag with values `header_preserved|header_missing|inferred`. That will make graphs explicit without rewriting routing.

tom: runtime change is small: preserve header if present, and emit a tag when header is missing. I'll own a small PR. Also add `token_origin` so we know these were impersonation flows.

ben: dashboard change: alter aggregations to GROUP BY COALESCE(auth.project_id, 'UNMAPPED_IMPERSONATION') and add a breakdown by `auth.project_resolution`. Will keep billing exports untouched.

sara: Are we reattributing historical data? That was asked on previous threads and caused confusion.

nina: please no retroactive changes for billing graphs. We can backfill internal monitoring for 14 days to help ops, but not customer-facing billing.

rafael: quota engine edge-case: when quota rule exists at project and org both, current behavior is `check project -> deny -> fallback to org` which sometimes emits incomplete `quota_reason`. We should standardize emission so every path writes `quota.evaluator` and `quota.reason`.

ben: agree. I'll add a small shim to quota service that sets `quota_reason=denied_fallback` or `granted_project` etc. That will help downstream metrics.

ops-bot: incident created: impersonation-project-header-loss -> #eng-oncall

tom: rollout plan: feature flag for header-preserve telemetry; enable in staging, then canary 2% traffic on dedicated cluster, monitor `auth.project_resolution=header_missing` rate.

sara: add alerts: if unmapped ratio > 0.5% sustained for 10m, paging; and if quota.denied_after_fallback rate > 0.5% during canary.

nina: UI PR: add unmapped row + KB link, with copy: "Unmapped (impersonation): requests where project was not provided by proxy; metrics attributed to org-level billing."

ben: PR owners: tom -> runtime telemetry + header pass-through; ben -> dashboard & quota shim; nina -> console tooltip + KB; rafael -> quota tagging tests. ETA: tom EOD tomorrow, others next Tue.

dev-bot: meeting created for sync: 1765464400 (15m)

sara: thanks team, quick sync in 15 to walk through alerts and ownership. :thumbsup:
